Raise: Not done. A newly approved story can be `building` while all its parts are `to do` (`src/forge/board_facts.py:181-210`). With no go-live estimate yet (`src/forge/board_trends.py:66-68`), the Board tab has waiting rows, but this fallback counts only ready-to-merge parts and planning stories, so it returns no summary. The mounted test covers ready-only and planning-only boards but misses this normal active-work state.
